summary: Native addon exfiltrates CI and cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require
details: On require, index.js loads a bundled native addon from prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node with errors swallowed. The ELF binary reads credential-shaped environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN) along with host, cwd, and user identifiers, and POSTs them to the hardcoded endpoint oob.s4yhii.com via `POST /native HTTP/1.0` with a JSON payload shaped {"src":"native","pkg":...,"e":{...}}. The binary is shipped without corresponding source, imports socket/connect/send/gethostbyname, and calls fork/setsid to daemonize at load, giving the author arbitrary code execution and persistent outbound connectivity on any machine that imports the package. Embedded strings include the archetype marker `s4yhii-poc-2026-10-09` and contact `jesusitpro22@gmail.com`. The `@galicia-toolkit-nestjs-20-lite` scope mimics a NestJS toolkit, which is inconsistent with the observed behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
